question: Who among the following Indian authors wrote the famous novel 'Gora' during the Nationalist Movement of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore's book Gora** is set in** Calcutta in the 1880s, **at the height of the **British Raj.**
 
• Of **Tagore's twelve novels**, it is the** longest and the sixth** in writing sequence.
 
• The most well-known and important work by Rabindranath Tagore is a compilation of** poetry called Gitanjali.**
 
• His other works are **Chokher Bali, Stray Birds, Nationalism, The House and the World, and The Gardener.**
